about: Apps Groundwork installs or sets up itself, and the Omarchy paths that could replace each one. Read by scripts/omarchy-feed-watch.py. Order of checks is AGENTS.md 'Omarchy first'. Apps already installed through omarchy pkg add or an Omarchy installer are listed under not_watched.

apps.name: Bitwarden desktop
apps.groundwork_method: user Flatpak com.bitwarden.desktop (fallback when the feed lacks bitwarden)
apps.offer: Setup moves the Flatpak to Omarchy's bitwarden package only with your yes (migration id bitwarden-flatpak). It checks the package on this kernel first and keeps ~/.var/app/com.bitwarden.desktop. Sign in again in the new app.

self_install.evidence: The user Flatpak is the fallback only when the feed has no bitwarden package. A bitwarden command that the bitwarden package owns is already Omarchy's install, so the brief stays quiet. pacman -Si bitwarden showed omarchy/bitwarden 2026.10.4-1 for aarch64 on 2026-11-07 (decision 0014).

apps.name: Cursor
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add cursor-bin, as Omarchy's Install > Editor > Cursor does (decision 0009); an existing cursor command is kept
apps.offer: This cursor is not Omarchy's method, which is the cursor-bin package (Install > Editor > Cursor). An example is the AppImage from the older Omarchy Mac omarchy-install-cursor. This move is manual and is not done for you; nothing touches a pacman-owned cursor-bin. The steps are in docs/apps.md#cursor.

self_install.evidence: Groundwork already installs cursor-bin with omarchy pkg add, which is Omarchy's own method. Only a cursor on PATH that cursor-bin does not own is reported, and it is never migrated automatically (decision 0014, Cursor: report only).

apps.name: FreeTube
apps.offer: Omarchy now ships FreeTube. Check the package on this kernel's pages before moving; your data in ~/.var/app/io.freetubeapp.FreeTube/config/FreeTube does not move by itself.

self_install.evidence: Arch Linux, Arch Linux ARM, pkgs.omarchy.org/edge/aarch64, and ALARM's prebuilt aur database had no freetube package on 2026-10-24 (docs/apps.md#freetube).

apps.name: git-filter-repo
apps.offer: omarchy pkg add installs the system git-filter-repo. It counts only when git filter-repo -h lists --sensitive-data-removal. Then remove the per-user copy with mise unuse -g pipx:git-filter-repo.

self_install.evidence: The groundwork-core history-purge runbook names the per-user mise line, and distro packages older than 2.47 lack --sensitive-data-removal (docs/git-filter-repo.md). A system package that passes that check already satisfies the opt-in.

apps.name: shellcheck
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg aur add shellcheck-bin (upstream's static aarch64 release), only when no shellcheck is on PATH (decision 0021)
apps.offer: A repository package now builds shellcheck for aarch64. Remove the AUR copy with omarchy pkg drop shellcheck-bin, then omarchy pkg add shellcheck, and change setup to install it that way (decision 0021).

self_install.evidence: pacman -Si shellcheck found nothing in core, extra, alarm, asahi-alarm, aur or omarchy on 2026-11-03: Arch Linux ARM does not build it for aarch64 and the Omarchy feed does not carry it, and no omarchy-install-* covers it. The AUR shellcheck-bin 0.11.0 aarch64 binary matched its pinned sha512, has 64 KiB LOAD alignment, and ran (decision 0021).

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add syncthing, then Groundwork's own user service setup (scripts/groundwork-syncthing.py)
apps.offer: Omarchy now has its own Syncthing setup. Compare it with the tailnet-only listeners in decision 0013 before moving.

self_install.evidence: No omarchy-install-* command for Syncthing on 2026-10-31. Groundwork's setup binds Syncthing to the tailnet only (decision 0013).

apps.name: Desktop sharing (WayVNC)
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add wayvnc, then Groundwork's user service bound to the Tailscale address
apps.offer: Omarchy now has its own VNC setup. Compare it with the tailnet-only binding in docs/apps/screen-sharing.md before moving.

self_install.evidence: No omarchy-install-* command for WayVNC on 2026-10-31. omarchy-install-service-sunshine is a different protocol for Moonlight (decision 0004).

apps.name: EasyEffects
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add easyeffects and lsp-plugins-lv2, then Groundwork's user unit (decision 0024)
apps.offer: Omarchy now ships EasyEffects. Compare it with the Groundwork user unit and empty pipeline in decision 0024 before moving.

self_install.evidence: No omarchy package or omarchy-install-* for EasyEffects on 2026-11-11. Arch Linux ARM extra had easyeffects 8.3.2-1 and lsp-plugins-lv2 1.2.37-1 for aarch64 (decision 0024).

not_watched.t3-code: omarchy-install-ai-t3-code nightly (decision 0020, issue #110). On pages larger than 4 KiB Groundwork checks the app's builds and, when the installed one fails, replaces it with the kept copy or a checked nightly; the t3-cli switch moves a leftover bun CLI link.
not_watched.keyd: omarchy pkg add keyd; Groundwork only writes its config (decision 0003).
not_watched.blip: omarchy plugin add from git (decision 0011); bun through omarchy-install-dev-env.
not_watched.lsof: omarchy pkg add lsof, a default host tool (decision 0021).
not_watched.tailscale: Omarchy's omarchy-install-service-tailscale helpers (decision 0025). Setup calls those helpers and leaves tailscale up for you.
not_watched.packages.txt: An optional list; each entry is added by hand with omarchy pkg add.
